title: Define read-only historical audit manifest and lifecycle
objective: Define a tamper-evident historical audit batch manifest plus a pure fail-closed lifecycle for bounded read-only audits, anchored to a source Git head and the ENG-07.1 batch identities, without executing audit work or mutating historical evidence.
non_goals: map requirements code tests or evidence
integrate the new checks into CI in this WU

required_invariants: historical audit manifest is read-only and tamper-evident
manifest lot set is ordered unique and restricted to historical Lots 0 through 44
manifest binds one ENG-07.1 plan identity and one batch identity
manifest source binding includes repository certified baseline and exact source head
historical evidence business code remediation and runtime mutation permissions are all false
manifest identity is SHA-256 over canonical manifest material excluding the identity field
BLOCKED manifests require explicit blockers and non-BLOCKED manifests cannot carry blockers
lifecycle transitions are explicit deterministic and fail-closed
COMPLETE cannot be reached directly from PLANNED READY or IN_PROGRESS
validator is pure and performs no audit or repository mutation
manifest validator replays the bound ENG-07.1 plan from its lot-complexity descriptors and requires canonical plan equality
acceptance_criteria: valid synthetic batch manifest validates and replays deterministically
tampering any identity-bound field invalidates manifest identity
Lot45 or out-of-range lot inclusion fails closed
unordered or duplicate lots fail closed
any write/remediation/runtime permission set true fails closed
baseline or source-head mismatch shape fails closed
BLOCKED without blocker fails and non-BLOCKED with blocker fails
legal lifecycle transitions pass and skipped/unknown transitions fail
schema and lifecycle policy drift are detected
no historical evidence or business/runtime state is mutated
forged plan identity or forged batch identity fails closed even when the manifest identity is recomputed

done_when: manifest schema lifecycle policy validator and adversarial tests are defined
manifest stays read-only source-bound and tamper-evident
lifecycle skips and mutation permissions fail closed
CI integration and executable qualification are deferred to a follow-up WU
